title: Two is better than one: A Collapse-free Multi-Reward RLIF Training Framework
abstract: arXiv:2605.22620v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has substantially improved the reasoning ability of LLMs, but often depends on external supervision from human annotations or gold-standard solutions. Reinforcement learning from internal feedback (RLIF) has recently emerged as a scalable unsupervised alternative, using signals extracted from the model itself. However, existing RLIF methods typically rely on a single internal reward, which can lead to reward hacking, entropy collapse, and degraded reasoning structure. We propose a multi-reward RLIF framework that decomposes the training signal into two complementary components: an answer-level reward based on cluster voting and a completion-level reward based on token-wise self-certainty. translated_title: 二胜于一：一种无崩溃的多奖励RLIF训练框架
translated_abstract: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已显著提升了大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力，但其通常依赖于来自人工标注或标准答案的外部监督。基于内部反馈的强化学习（RLIF）最近作为一种可扩展的无监督替代方案出现，它利用从模型自身提取的信号进行训练。然而，现有的RLIF方法通常依赖单一内部奖励，这可能导致奖励破解、熵坍缩以及推理结构退化。我们提出了一种多奖励RLIF框架，将训练信号分解为两个互补的组成部分：基于聚类投票的答案级奖励和基于逐词元自确信度的补全级奖励。为了稳健地结合这些信号，我们采用基于GDPO的归一化方法来缓解奖励尺度的不平衡。我们进一步引入了KL-Cov正则化，针对低熵词元分布进行约束……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种无崩溃的多奖励RLIF无监督训练框架，将基于聚类投票的答案级奖励与基于词元自确信度的补全级奖励相结合，并通过GDPO归一化和KL-Cov正则化有效避免奖励破解与熵坍缩，从而提升大语言模型的推理能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a collapse-free multi-reward RLIF framework that combines a cluster-voting-based answer-level reward with a token-wise self-certainty completion-level reward, using GDPO-based normalization and KL-Cov regularization to prevent reward hacking and entropy collapse in unsupervised LLM reasoning training.
